ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black mass occupying the inner 60 percent of both lobes. High-intensity white pigmentation localized at distal tips, with a jagged, mottled transition zone between color masses.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with multiple acute indentations (notches) along the trailing edge; serrations are more pronounced on the left lobe's upper margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a convex curve from the notch towards the pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast beige/white pixel blobs localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single prominent dark vertical linear mark on the white field of the right lobe; complex intersecting linear marks on the white field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized barnacle colonization at the lateral tips of both lobes; significant linear rake marks across white pigmentation zones.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive X-shaped or cross-hatched linear pattern on the lower white-pigmented section of the left lobe.
